title: Admission Rate Calculator
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Calculate a college's admission rate from its applications and admits, and see why a surge in applications lowers the rate even when admits stay the same.

learningObjectives: Students will calculate a college's admission rate from its applicant and admit counts and explain how a change in applications changes the rate even when the number of admitted students stays the same.
prerequisites: Chapter 1: The College Landscape and Application Rounds

controls: College A and College B buttons

keyQuestions: Why can a college's admission rate fall even when it admits the same number of students?
Does a 15% admission rate mean you personally have a 15% chance? Why not?
What band is a college with 25,000 applicants and 5,000 admits in?
commonMisconceptions: The admission rate is your personal chance of admission.
A falling admission rate means a college's education got better.
assessmentOpportunities: Students compute an admission rate correctly from two counts, place it in the right selectivity band, and explain the effect of an application surge in their own words.
